info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create It Management Technology Standard-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the establishment and management of technology standards within IT systems. It allows organizations to define, create, and update technology standards that align with their internal policies and compliance requirements. Typical consumers include IT governance teams, compliance officers, and systems administrators who aim to streamline processes and ensure technological consistency across their operations. By utilizing this API, organizations can improve their technology management practices and ensure adherence to required standards.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new technology standard within the IT management system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to add a new standard that will be used across the organization.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating technology standards in the IT management system. This body should contain the relevant details and specifications as defined in the schema.

policyId.description: The unique identifier for the policy.

title.description: The title of the technology standard.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for the technology standard.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the policy becomes effective.

reviewDate.description: The date for the next review of the policy.

applicability.description: List of applicable areas or teams for this policy.

CreateItManagementTechnologyStandardRequ.description: Schema for creating a new technology standard operation request.

requestId.description: The unique identifier for the request.

idempotencyKey.description: Key to ensure that requests are idempotent.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was made.

sourceSystem.description: The system from which the request originated.

sourceApplication.description: The application from which the request originated.

channel.description: Information about the channel through which the request was made.

RequestContext.description: Schema for the context of the request.

channelId.description: The unique identifier for the communication channel.

Channel.description: Schema representing the channel details of the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). It allows clients to authenticate by including a bearer token in the Authorization header of HTTP requests. The bearer token should be a valid JWT that has been issued by the authorization server.
